phase: P5 concurrency, crash and durable-worker fault tolerance

fault_scenarios.injection_point: terminate the worker after durable claim or domain mutation begins and before the attacked transaction commits
fault_scenarios.expected_durable_state: no partial attacked transaction; the command is recoverable after lease expiry or remains eligible according to the pre-commit state

fault_scenarios.injection_point: terminate after the durable transaction commits and before Celery or the broker records task acknowledgement
fault_scenarios.expected_durable_state: redelivery observes the committed result and cannot repeat the logical business effect

fault_scenarios.injection_point: persist provider-side success or acceptance, then break the database acknowledgement transaction
fault_scenarios.expected_durable_state: local state remains non-terminal until same-identity replay or reconciliation stores authoritative evidence; no new provider identity is created

fault_scenarios.injection_point: deliver the same Celery task and durable command sequentially and concurrently
fault_scenarios.expected_durable_state: duplicates converge on one logical command/effect and cannot overwrite newer authoritative state

fault_scenarios.injection_point: expire a live claim, reclaim it with a replacement owner and resume the stale owner
fault_scenarios.expected_durable_state: only the current ownership generation can write completion or failure; the stale owner is rejected

fault_scenarios.injection_point: interrupt Redis/broker or provider network before delivery, during processing and before acknowledgement
fault_scenarios.expected_durable_state: PostgreSQL business meaning is unchanged; replacement processes reach bounded retry, reconciliation or dead letter without false success

fault_scenarios.injection_point: disconnect the database at claim, domain mutation and provider acknowledgement boundaries
fault_scenarios.expected_durable_state: each attempt is either rolled back or recoverable according to its commit point and no durable job disappears

fault_scenarios.injection_point: run conflicting lifecycle transitions and force a real deadlock or serialization victim across independent sessions
fault_scenarios.expected_durable_state: one authoritative transition wins; loser behavior is explicit and retry-safe; dependent effects match the winner exactly once

fault_scenarios.injection_point: race lifecycle refund evaluation with payment allocation, settlement or refund-state changes
fault_scenarios.expected_durable_state: locked current authority determines the result; stale queue values cannot create an obligation and at most one logical refund obligation exists

fault_scenarios.injection_point: terminate compensation before commit and after commit but before task acknowledgement, then replay
fault_scenarios.expected_durable_state: one authoritative compensated state and one logical history/effect set exist; no aggregate remains frozen without recovery disposition
